questions.q: What is the core difference between a Text field and a Picklist field?
options: A Picklist restricts input to an admin-defined list of values; Text accepts anything typed
A Picklist can only hold numbers
A Text field is always required; a Picklist never is
There is no real difference
questions.explain: A Picklist only accepts values from a defined list, while a Text field accepts any typed input up to its length limit.

questions.q: When is Picklist (Multi-Select) the right choice over a plain Picklist?
options: Always — multi-select is strictly better
Never — it is deprecated
Only when more than one value at a time is a genuine, expected answer
Only on standard objects
questions.explain: Multi-select fits cases where multiple simultaneous values are genuinely expected (like a product's certifications); most fields describe one state at a time and should stay single-select.

questions.q: What does checking "Restrict picklist to the values defined in the value set" actually enforce?
options: Nothing — it is purely cosmetic
It blocks the API, automation, and integrations from writing a value not on the list, not just the UI
It deletes any existing values not on the list
It converts the picklist into a Text field
questions.explain: Unchecked, the UI restricts users but the API does not; checking this box enforces the value list at the API level too.

questions.q: What does this lesson point out about Lead Source on the Lead object?
options: It's a custom field built specifically for this course
It's a standard picklist Salesforce ships out of the box, using the same mechanics as a custom one
It can't be edited at all
It is a Multi-Select picklist
questions.explain: Lead Source is a standard picklist — built into the org rather than admin-created, but working the same way as any custom picklist.

questions.q: Once a new picklist field is saved, where does it appear?
options: Only in the Schema Builder canvas, never in Object Manager
In the object's Fields & Relationships list, in the same table as every other field
In a separate "Picklists" tab unrelated to the object
It does not appear anywhere until a report is built
questions.explain: A saved picklist field shows up in Fields & Relationships exactly like any other field, with the same Field Label, Field Name, and Data Type columns.
